reason: A offers the more physically plausible mechanism: disorder-induced lattice distortions can alter phonons and electron–phonon coupling, with paired structural and superconducting measurements enabling a controlled correlation test. B incorrectly treats ordinary chemical-disorder scattering as generally pair-breaking in a conventional s-wave BCS superconductor and assumes annealing both reduces scattering and strengthens electron–phonon coupling, neither of which follows without evidence.
